summary: Full backend regression after the monolithic server.py → layered app/ package refactor. All 38/38 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py PASS in 12.79s against the public preview URL. No 500s, no tracebacks in backend logs during the run. Public API contract is byte-for-byte preserved: /api/ now returns the active default hub object (not the previous hardcoded constant), hubs CRUD + default-flag promotion, hub-managers/drivers/vehicles/zones/orders flows, all 3 routing modes (time/eco/avoid_erp) with OSRM Python fallback, simulate-step, shipper inbox, LTA passthrough (incidents/speed-bands/erp-rates), geocode happy-path + 422 validation, and seed all behave identically to iteration_2.
action_items: None blocking. Refactor is a clean drop-in replacement.

Optional polish: add unit tests at the service layer (services/clustering, services/routing, services/assignment) — current suite is integration-level only and would not isolate a service-level regression.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 47 lines — well within the <700-line guideline. Each router file is <170 lines as advertised.
@asynccontextmanager lifespan replaces the deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — iteration_2 review item resolved.
/api/ no longer hardcodes a hub constant; it returns the live default hub from the DB — verified via curl and TestHealth.test_root.
Hub default-flag enforcement still atomic on both create and delete-promotes-another paths — verified by TestHubs::test_default_enforcement_on_create and test_delete_default_promotes_another.
Routing endpoint still honours optional hub_id override and falls back to default hub when omitted — verified by TestRoutingWithHub (both cases).
Vehicle one-to-one assignment swap (assign v2 unassigns v1) still works — verified by TestVehicles::test_assign_swap.
Geocode still returns 200 with results list (not 500) when Nominatim is reachable, and 422 for q shorter than min_length — both verified.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in the system
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed at session start produced 3 hubs / 2 HMs / 6 drivers / 6 vehicles / 3 zones / 15 orders as required by FR spec
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend now lives in /app/backend/app/ (config, database, logging, utils, seed + models/, services/, routers/). server.py is a 47-line entrypoint that only wires CORS+lifespan and includes app.routers.api_router. Public URL https://20e68ae9-3b04-460d-9e68-493a3ff17270.preview.emergentagent.com. Run regression with: BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. OSRM is unreachable in env — Python NN-TSP fallback handles routing; tests tolerate it. Nominatim IS reachable. LTA datamall passthrough works.
